purpose: WO-LMFG-003 (WO-D02): the real ZTL Engineer -> ZTL Stand -> checker route, reused from the pinned commits without modification; materialized at test time into git-ignored _deps/
reuse_mode: blob-less sparse fetch of the pinned commit; every file verified by git blob SHA-1, size and SHA-256 before use; never edited, never committed into this repository

repositories.name: ztl-engineer

repositories.name: ztl-stand
repositories.role: the stand (verdicts EARNED / REFUTED / OPEN) and its independent checker; its own tests and examples

repositories.name: ZTL
repositories.role: the numeric judge the stand imports (ustand/judge_ztl.py: znumjudge, znumsolve) via USTAND_ZTL
